title: Containment requirement
description: What isolation a module needs, and — separately — what the host can actually provide. The two must never be conflated: a policy check is not a kernel boundary, and saying so is mandatory.

granted_tier.description: UNAVAILABLE is a valid and expected answer. A host that cannot provide the required tier must say so and refuse, never silently downgrade to in_process.

enforcement_kind.description: policy_only means the isolation is an in-process check. It must be reported as such and must never be described as containment.

attested.description: Whether the granted tier was independently verified rather than assumed from configuration.

then.description: In-process execution is policy enforcement. It may not claim any stronger enforcement_kind.
Untrusted and generated code requires a real boundary, not a hardened container.
